author: Vincent Augerot
name: HardSlice query slice
description: A query slice of a hardslice-api solution: query, DTO, handler reading its aggregate without tracking, endpoint and integration tests, and with --result filtered and --parameters <Name>:<Type>[,...] the validator of its filters and its tests. --route chooses the route of its endpoint, which answers GET, and --require <policy> protects it with an authorization policy of the application, and tests its 401. Run it from the root of the solution with --project src/<App>/<App>.csproj.

Module.description: The module of the slice, in PascalCase, such as Bookings: src/<App>/Features/<Module>/<Module>Module.cs must exist.

Aggregate.description: The aggregate that the query reads, in PascalCase, such as Booking: a type of namespace <App>.Domain.<Module>, whose Id property is a <Aggregate>Id that wraps a Guid Value.

Result.description: What the query returns: single (one DTO read by its id, null answered with 404, by default), many (the list of the DTOs) or filtered (the list of the DTOs that the filters of --parameters select, each read from the query string, or from the route when --route names it, and checked by a validator). Not list: dotnet new would read it as its list command.

choices.description: One DTO read by its id; an unknown id is answered with 404.
The list of the DTOs that the filters of --parameters select, each from the query string, where a request without it is answered with 400, or from the route.

Parameters.description: The filters of --result filtered, as <Name>:<Type>[,<Name>:<Type>...]: PascalCase names, each with one of the types string, bool, int, long, decimal, double, Guid, DateOnly, TimeOnly and DateTimeOffset, such as Date:DateOnly or From:DateOnly,To:DateOnly. The query reads each filter from the query string, such as ?from=2026-11-04&to=2026-11-05, where its validator answers 400 to a request without it, or from the route when --route names it between braces, such as days/{date}, where a value that its binding refuses is answered with 400. Each filter has a rule of the validator, its unit test, and its test of the 400. Required with --result filtered, refused otherwise.

Route.description: The route of the endpoint under the group of the module, chosen after the resource it reads rather than the use case: lowercase words separated by hyphens, and route parameters between braces such as {id:guid}, separated by slashes, such as trips or {roomId:guid}/bookings, or / for the group itself. The name of the slice in kebab-case by default. With --result single, /{id:guid} follows it. With --result filtered, each route parameter names a filter of --parameters, such as days/{date}, and nothing else.

Method.description: The HTTP method of the endpoint: GET, the only method of a query, which only reads.

Require.description: Protects the endpoint with the authorization policy of that name, which the application registers in Shared/Http with its authentication scheme, such as AdminKey: the endpoint chains .RequireAuthorization("<policy>"), an integration test asserts its 401 without authentication, and the other tests send their requests through app.CreateAuthorizedClient("<policy>"), the client of that policy that AppFactory.AuthorizedClients holds. A name of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-', starting with a letter.

steps.replacement: // $1, from the query string: nullable, so that the validator answers 400 to a request without it.
// $1, from the route parameter $4: its binding answers 400 to a value that it cannot read as $3, before the validator.
// $1, from the route parameter $4: its constraint lets no value that it refuses reach the endpoint (404).
// $1, from the route parameter $4: its binding takes any text, so the validator holds the rules of its format.

Accepted.value: (AppIsKnown && NameIsGiven && NameIsPascalCase && !NameHasSuffix && ModuleIsPascalCase && ModuleExists && AggregateIsPascalCase && RouteIsValid && !RouteHidesId && MethodIsGet && !ParametersIsMissing && !ParametersIsUnused && !ParametersIsMalformed && !ParameterTypeIsUnknown && !ParameterIsDuplicated && !RouteNamesNoFilter && RequireIsValid)

postActions.description: Refuses a solution whose web project it cannot read.

manualInstructions.text: error: hardslice-query reads the application from its web project, which it could not evaluate. Run it from the root of the solution with --project src/<App>/<App>.csproj, once the solution is restored (after a first build or check), such as: dotnet new hardslice-query --project src/<App>/<App>.csproj --module <Module> --name <Name> --aggregate <Aggregate>. Nothing was created.
error: --name is required: the use case in PascalCase, without the Query suffix, such as --name ListRoomBookings. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a name that is not PascalCase.

manualInstructions.text: error: --name 'QueryName' is not PascalCase: it names the slice folder, its namespace and its types, such as --name ListRoomBookings. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a name with the Query suffix.

manualInstructions.text: error: --name 'QueryName' ends with Query: pass the use case alone, the template names the query <Name>Query. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a module name that is not PascalCase.

manualInstructions.text: error: --module 'ModuleName' is not PascalCase: pass the name of an existing module, such as the folder of src/MyApp/Features/<Module>/. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a module that does not exist.

manualInstructions.text: error: module 'ModuleName' does not exist: src/MyApp/Features/ModuleName/ModuleNameModule.cs was not found. Create the module first with dotnet new hardslice-module --project src/MyApp/MyApp.csproj --name ModuleName, then add the slice. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses an aggregate name that is not PascalCase.

manualInstructions.text: error: --aggregate 'AggregateName' is not PascalCase: pass the aggregate root that the query reads, a type of src/MyApp.Domain/<Module>/, such as --aggregate Booking. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a route that ASP.NET Core or the tests could not use.

manualInstructions.text: error: --route '/slice-route' is not a route of lowercase words separated by hyphens, and route parameters between braces such as {id:guid}, separated by slashes, such as --route trips or --route {roomId:guid}/bookings. Pass --route / for the group of the module itself. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a route that already holds the parameter that a single result appends.

manualInstructions.text: error: --route '/slice-route' holds a parameter id, which --result single appends to it as /{id:guid} to read the aggregate by its identifier. Remove it from --route, such as --route trips, or pass / for the group of the module. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a method other than GET.

manualInstructions.text: error: --method 'HttpMethodName' is not GET: a query only reads and answers GET. A use case that changes state is a command, generated with dotnet new hardslice-command, which takes --method POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a filtered result without its filter.

manualInstructions.text: error: --result filtered needs --parameters <Name>:<Type>[,<Name>:<Type>...], the filters that the query reads from the query string or from its route, such as --parameters Date:DateOnly or --parameters From:DateOnly,To:DateOnly. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a filter that the result does not read.

manualInstructions.text: error: --parameters 'ParametersText' lists the filters of --result filtered: pass --result filtered with it, or leave it out for --result single, which reads its aggregate by its id, or --result many, which lists every aggregate. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a filter that is not <Name>:<Type>.

manualInstructions.text: error: --parameters 'ParametersText' is not a list of <Name>:<Type> separated by commas, each a PascalCase name and its type separated by a colon, such as --parameters Date:DateOnly or --parameters From:DateOnly,To:DateOnly. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a filter of a type that the template does not generate.

manualInstructions.text: error: --parameters 'ParametersText' gives UnknownParameterName the type 'UnknownParameterType', which is not one of string, bool, int, long, decimal, double, Guid, DateOnly, TimeOnly and DateTimeOffset, written as in C#. For another type, such as an enum of the domain, generate the query with the closest of them, then change the type of the query, of its validator and of its tests. Nothing was created.

error: --parameters 'ParametersText' names DuplicateParameterName twice, whatever its case: each filter is a parameter of the query, read from the query string or from the route by its name. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a route parameter that names no filter of a filtered result.

manualInstructions.text: error: --route '/slice-route' holds the route parameter 'unknown-route-parameter', which names no filter of the query: --result filtered binds from the route each filter of --parameters 'ParametersText' that a route parameter names, such as --route days/{date} --parameters Date:DateOnly. Name the filter in the route, or remove the parameter from --route to read the filter from the query string. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a policy name that the generated code could not hold.

manualInstructions.text: error: --require 'AuthorizationPolicyName' is not the name of an authorization policy that the template can write: letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-', starting with a letter, such as --require AdminKey. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Lines to add to the module of the slice.
What the policy of the endpoint asks of the application and of its tests.

manualInstructions.text: The endpoint requires the authorization policy AuthorizationPolicyName, which the application registers in src/MyApp/Shared/Http/ with its authentication scheme (docs/rules/HS015.md). Its integration tests send their requests through app.CreateAuthorizedClient("AuthorizationPolicyName"), which fails until AuthorizedClients, in tests/MyApp.IntegrationTests/AppFactory.cs, holds the client of that policy, and assert its 401 without authentication.
